tip.cash: Your company's cash. Earned from phone sales minus unit costs, upkeep and development.
tip.brand: Brand value (0–100). Grows with good reviews and makes every phone more attractive.
tip.fans: Fans buy at launch (pre-orders) and grow with every well-reviewed phone.
tip.date: Game time. One day passes every 5 seconds at 1x.
tip.design: Design score 0–10: material, thickness, screen-to-body, size, color and proportions – measured against this era's expectations.
tip.tech: Tech score 0–10: chip, display, battery, camera, storage and RAM compared with what the market expects this year.
tip.review: Forecast review score (±0.5). Higher reviews sell far more phones.
tip.unitCost: What one phone costs you to build: parts, materials, assembly and packaging.
tip.price: Retail price, set automatically to a fair value for now.
tip.devTime: Development time in game days (founder working alone).
tip.devCost: One-off development cost, paid when development starts.
tip.weekly: Expected sales in the first weeks. The garage can build 50 phones per week.

tutorial.color: Pick a color – your phone gets painted live.
tutorial.display: Pick a display size. Bigger looks great but drains the battery.

good.color: That color is spot-on for this season.
good.thin: Impressively thin – it slides into any pocket.
good.screen: The screen dominates the front. Gorgeous.
good.display: A display that's just the right size.
good.battery: Battery easily lasts the whole day.
good.performance: Snappy and smooth in everyday use.

bad.color: The color feels a bit out of fashion.
bad.screen: Too much bezel, too little screen.
bad.battery: The battery struggles to last a day.

teaser.office: Only {amount} to go until your first office!
teaser.secondLaunch: Design your next phone – each one makes your brand stronger.
teaser.officeReady: Your startup office is ready. Hiring and research arrive in the next update!
